subject.title: fix(memory-lancedb): gate auto-recall/auto-capture on per-agent memorySearch.enabled (#103590)

question: Should memorySearch.enabled govern only memory-lancedb automatic recall and capture, while explicit memory tools and physical per-agent database isolation remain separate work?
rationale: The reported automatic disclosure path is concrete and the resolver repair is mechanical, but the permanent scope of the cross-agent sensitive-memory boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt automatic-only gating
options.body: Use the canonical SDK resolver, obtain live two-agent proof, and land this focused repair while tracking broader isolation separately if desired.

options.title: Gate all plugin memory access
options.body: Expand the contract so a disabled agent also cannot invoke memory-lancedb recall, store, or forget tools.

options.title: Require physical agent isolation
options.body: Pause this PR and design per-agent storage, legacy-data migration, CLI behavior, and upgrade semantics together.

recommendation.title: Adopt automatic-only gating
recommendation.body: Use the canonical SDK resolver, obtain live two-agent proof, and land this focused repair while tracking broader isolation separately if desired.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history provides the strongest sustained ownership signal across memory-lancedb hardening and plugin SDK boundary decisions.
